title: NES controller-port bridge, v1b
intro: The bench drives an unmodified NES-001 through its controller port and records what it does. This package is the v1b build: an Arduino UNO between a Raspberry Pi and the console, on one 5 V rail.

Nothing is placed or typed by hand: the schematic's coordinates come from the parts' own sizes, and every list and diagram here is read back out of it, the lab log and the bring-up tool. Three sheets are ANSI B: their type would print below 5 pt on letter, and the package refuses that.
AUTHORED means not yet measured. MEASURED carries its date and its record in docs/lab-notebook.md.
